policy_title: Extend Free School Meals to All Children in Poverty
stated: Extend free school meals to all children in poverty, with an ambition to extend them to all primary school children when the public finances allow.

source.quote: Extend free school meals to all children in poverty, with an ambition to extend them to all primary school children when the public finances allow.

bearing_set.reason: Directly targets food access for children in poverty, which affects attainment and the opportunity gap — a core education and opportunity indicator.
Reduces effective household food costs for low-income families whose children qualify, materially improving disposable income on essentials.
Explicitly targeting children in poverty makes this a redistributive measure; it narrows the gap in nutritional access and associated educational outcomes between income groups.

Expanding eligibility beyond the current restricted threshold is a material new public spending commitment — acknowledged implicitly by the 'when public finances allow' caveat for the broader primary-school ambition.

membership_note: Four genuine bearings: O7 (attainment/nutrition link), O2 (food-cost relief for poor households), O14 (redistributive targeting narrows income-group gap), O12 (real fiscal cost). No liberty or safety spillovers meet the non-negligible threshold.
